changelog:
You can save a backup of your setup, and send the app's log with one tap from More.

WHAT CHANGED

- Settings has a new Backup & Restore section. Export a backup saves your settings, your sources and your category choices to a file you choose, as a zip you can open on a computer.
- Passwords are left out of a backup unless you turn on Include passwords, which warns you first. Without it, provider logins and any login inside a link are removed.
- If saving a backup fails or is cancelled, no half-written file is left behind.
- More has a new Send log and backup option. It hands the app's log and a backup, named with the same date and time, to any app you choose, such as email or Drive.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else. The log still has your provider's details removed.

NOT YET

- Favourites and watch history are not in backups yet, and restoring a backup is still to come.
